digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and packaged guide
propositions: Author-facing documentation must explain that risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after a slow delivery loop (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning) must be de-risked via fast out-of-loop proof before codification.
The packaged plan guide must name T15 as the criterion that governs the slow-loop de-risk behavior and must specify the two permitted proof forms: local run or manual probe against real target.
Plan guide cleanup guidance must limit teardown scope to resources created by the throwaway experiment only.
The criterion-pins manifest, hand-authored gate docs, and registry module docstring must all reflect the validated vocabulary of 44 criteria covering T1–T15 range.
Guidance must remain stack-agnostic and never hardcode product-specific mechanisms like Terraform or Docker.
